verdict.rationale: BAMF is a German federal government agency for migration and asylum, and its evidence describes informational and advisory services (migration and residence info, integration offers, service teams, statistics). Versioned developer APIs with a deprecation policy fall outside the kind of offering such a public-authority information service is compared on. Nothing in the evidence shows BAMF ships any API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
